items.summary: fp16 overflow at training/uma_ai/model.py:199 — logits.masked_fill(~action_mask.bool(), -1.0e9) overflows at::Half. Triggered when train_bc.py --amp is used on CUDA. Surfaced 2026-05-14 during R7.b.2 first-launch attempt; workaround was to drop --amp. Real fix: replace -1.0e9 with torch.finfo(logits.dtype).min (or -1e4 if simpler). One-line + smoke. Low priority (workaround works).
items.next_action: Implementer: change training/uma_ai/model.py:199 constant from -1.0e9 to torch.finfo(logits.dtype).min (one line), add assert_amp_overflow_regression smoke in training/smoke_e2e.py that loads model in fp16 and runs forward without RuntimeError or NaN logits, wire smoke into test:python-train, commit.
